summary: Carriage Services filed an 8-K on May 6, 2026, disclosing entry into an Equity Distribution Agreement with Oppenheimer and Raymond James to sell up to $100M of common stock in at-the-market offerings. Sales occur at prevailing market prices; the company is not obligated to sell. The agents receive up to 3% commission. This is a routine at-the-market shelf takedown, not a special situation. No special-situation classification applies.
